_: How a field battle plays (army_field.gd, army_melee.gd and combat.gd read it through data.gd; docs/TUNING.md). kickLands: a kick's chance to land. dodge: the chance a blow that misses is a dodge rather than a parry. kickOdds: how often a swordsman kicks instead of cutting. floored: the chance a heavy blow that doesn't kill knocks a man down. field: the massed battle of two hosts (army_field.gd on army.gd's regiments): gap, the lines' middles apart when they deploy; start, seconds both lines stand before it begins; advance, the foot's pace to contact (units a second); contact, the gap between front ranks at blows; overlap, how much of two fronts must face each other across the line before they are at blows (share of their blocks' half widths together; a regiment off to the side closes square on its foe's front first); longest, seconds at blows before the beaten break whatever their strength. volley: seconds between an archer regiment's volleys (low, high), arrows in one (at most: one an archer standing), draw_s (seconds every archer draws together before they loose), step (seconds the loosing spreads over), angle (radians over the flat they loose at) and gravity (world units a second squared: the flight and its arc come from these and the range, a true ballistic arc), spread (world units off the man aimed at, in the target block), men it fells (low, high), and how near the lines may come before archers stop (until). fight: men a regiment in contact loses a second (beaten, victors; the outcome is the realm's, Freeciv's), seconds between a front man's blows (low, high), the chance a front man reels instead (hitOdds) or takes a blow on his shield (blockOdds), ranks that fight, how far the front surges, how much harder a flanked regiment bleeds,. cavalry: ride and charge pace, how far round the enemy's end it swings (wide), how far behind its front it turns in (behind), and the men its charge fells at once where it strikes (shock). waver: strength below which a beaten regiment's banner wavers; rout: below which it breaks; run: its pace in flight; loose.spread: how wide of straight away each loose man of a broken regiment runs (across, per unit away; each his own body through the field's crowd, research note step 7); fade: seconds before the routed are gone. camera: the lens's quarter off the lines and how fast it follows; at blows it comes in to close of its distance and looks down pitch degrees (the press fills the frame). field.play: battles in play (scenes.gd stages one where the bridge tells of a battle, always): the lines' middles apart there, men in a regiment for each company that fought, the most companies shown a side, how many such battles at once (more are told, not shown), seconds the field stays held before the living go, aftermath: seasons the fallen and the broken regiments' dropped standards (dropped: their length, units) then lie on the field, kinds: the companies [beaten, victors] of a battle staged where no scene named them (the film's, the shot harness's). field.turns: bearings tried round the crown's muster for the foe's line, the one on the most fit ground taken; ground.*: where a battle may be fought (battlefield): field (how far the fight reaches from its centre), rise (the most the ground may rise or fall across the field), rings (how far out, in rings 0.8 apart, it is looked for), town_clear (how far its edge keeps from a town), farm_clear (its centre from a farmstead, past the field), rough (what each kind of land costs it).

general._: army_general.gd, each host's captain: think, seconds between his reads of the field once the lines are locked; horse_vs_horse, how much nearer a foe's horse counts than a foe block at blows when he picks his horse's mark (under 1: horse goes for horse first); losing, the foe's captain changes his order once his side's strength and nerve fall under this share of the King's; fallback, the order he changes to.

field._reach: reach: a foot regiment whose front is within this of its foe's front is at blows wherever its spot was (army_field.gd _advance). opposite: how much the distance ahead counts against the distance across the front when a foot regiment picks the foe in front of it (_opposite_foe; 0: purely the one across, 1: the nearest).

charge._: army_field.gd _advance: foot walk in at advance, then run the last stretch: within from (world units) of the foe's front, at pace, the run clip and the charge cry (soundscape charge).

combat._: army_combat.gd, who bleeds at blows (Total War's melee): base men a second a regiment of men_ref men loses to one foe of equal strength on its front; flank and rear: times that from the side or behind (front_cos, rear_cos: the angle's cosine bounds); nerve_floor and wind_floor: how hard a regiment with no nerve or no wind still hits (share); wind: stamina a second spent at blows (fight), running (run), won back standing (rest); kinds.<role>: attack, defence (against foot), horse (against a charge), arrows (against arrows).

prisoners._: Prisoners led away after the battle (army_field.gd _prisoners): per_regiment men for each beaten regiment that broke, most at most, guards of the victors at the head and at the tail, gap between them in the file, pace (world units a second), back: how far behind the victors' line they are led.
